page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraving of the Crucifixion, with a small page number at the foot. A blue library stamp lies over the lower right corner and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Engraving of the crucified Christ with nails, a hammer and pincers at the foot of the cross, and a townscape with buildings and hills. No printed text appears within the engraving. The blue circular library stamp in the lower right is excluded.
